# Sahaya

> Sahaya runs music marketing campaigns and books paid live shows for independent artists in the UK. It reads the signals around an artist's music to find the song people keep coming back to, spot the moment it's ready to move, and decide where the money should go. Sahaya is from Based Audio and lives at basedaudio.co.uk.

## Key facts

- Who it's for: independent artists at different stages of their career
- Campaign channels: playlisting, Meta ads, UGC (creators using the artist's sound), TikTok, YouTube and live shows
- Pricing: every campaign is tailored to the artist's budget; Sahaya picks the channel mix that will do the most for that budget at the artist's current stage
- Roster: 115+ artists on Sahaya; 20+ records backed with real campaigns
- Data Sahaya learns from: 2,000+ tracks monitored and 12B+ historical catalogue streams observed (these are streams observed in artists' catalogue data, not streams generated by Sahaya campaigns)
- Live: Sahaya Live books paid shows across the UK, starting in London, Birmingham, Manchester and Newcastle. The promoter pays the performance fee; there is no joining fee for artists
- Based in the United Kingdom. Contact: michael@basedaudio.co.uk. Instagram: @basedaudio.co.uk

## Pages

- [Sahaya for independent artists](https://www.basedaudio.co.uk/): how a campaign works, the channels, records backed, case studies (Zone Four: 57 to 75.4K monthly listeners; Jamilah: 92 to 14.4K monthly listeners), FAQ and contact form
- [Sahaya Live](https://www.basedaudio.co.uk/live.html): paid live bookings for independent artists, and briefs for promoters and venues
- [On Record, Q2 2026](https://www.basedaudio.co.uk/on-record.html): five lessons for artists from 28.1M streams, 34 new releases and 9 campaigns tracked on Sahaya between April and June 2026

## Research

- [Q2 2026 Streaming Intelligence Report (PDF)](https://www.basedaudio.co.uk/based-audio-q2-2026-report.pdf): full methodology, charts and anonymised release-level data
